content.short: Daedalus Wallet is the first mobile wallet for the Aptos and Sui Blockchains.
content.description: Managing wallets across multiple chains can be confusing and time-consuming. Daedalus Wallet serves as a unified wallet aggregator, bringing together access to Sui, Aptos, Ethereum, Avalanche, Solana, Polygon, BNB Chain, Multichain, and Arbitrum in a single, coherent interface. It streamlines everyday activity by letting you view balances, send assets, and sign transactions across networks without juggling separate apps, reducing fragmentation and making cross-chain workflows more straightforward.
content.meta: Daedalus Wallet is the first mobile wallet for the Aptos and Sui Blockchains. Discover Daedalus Wallet and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
